adjudication.rationale: The diff shows multiple duplicated `destinationCalendar` normalizations to an array, and they have drifted: `requestReschedule.handler.ts` now sets `destinationCalendar` to `[bookingToReschedule.destinationCalendar]` or `[]` (no `user.destinationCalendar` fallback), while most other handlers include a user fallback; `handleNewBooking.ts` sets it to `null` instead of `[]`. This drift can surface a real runtime error introduced by the array refactor: in `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` is followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` (no optional chaining), which will throw a TypeError when `destinationCalendar` is `null` or `[]` (i.e., `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined`).
